steps.name: scaffolding - create project layout, Makefile (real TABs), sample C sources
steps.description: Create minimal project layout under the authoritative workspace (src/, tests/, bin/), generate portable Makefile using printf to ensure real TAB characters, add sample C sources. Determine sanitizer policy by testing -fsanitize=address support: prefer ASAN by default but fall back if unsupported or if VALGRIND_FORCE=1 (or environment sets preference). Generated runtime scripts do NOT hardcode workspace path — they discover workspace via WS env or relative location.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/subtree-parent-finder-3384-3393/native_c_subtree_parent_finder"
mkdir -p "$WS/src" "$WS/tests" "$WS/bin"
# Sample C implementation
cat > "$WS/src/subtree_parent_finder.c" <<'C_SRC'
#include <stdio.h>
int find_parent_stub(void){ return 42; }
C_SRC
cat > "$WS/src/main.c" <<'C_MAIN'
#include <stdio.h>
int find_parent_stub(void);
int main(void){ printf("%d\n", find_parent_stub()); return 0; }
C_MAIN
# Detect ASAN support: try compiling a tiny program with -fsanitize=address
tmpc=$(mktemp --suffix=.c)
cat > "$tmpc" <<'C'
int main(){return 0;}
C
ASAN_OK=0
if gcc -fsanitize=address -g -O0 "$tmpc" -o /dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1; then ASAN_OK=1; fi
rm -f "$tmpc"
# Determine sanitizer policy
USE_ASAN=0
if [ "${VALGRIND_FORCE:-0}" != "1" ] && [ "$ASAN_OK" -eq 1 ]; then
  USE_ASAN=1
fi
if [ "$USE_ASAN" -eq 1 ]; then
  CFLAGS="-O2 -Wall -fsanitize=address -g"
  LDFLAGS="-fsanitize=address"
else
  CFLAGS="-O2 -Wall"
  LDFLAGS=""
fi
# Write Makefile using printf to ensure real TAB characters in recipes and allow env overrides
OUT="$WS/Makefile"
printf '%s
' "CC ?= gcc" "CFLAGS ?= ${CFLAGS}" "LDFLAGS ?= ${LDFLAGS}" "SRC=src/main.c src/subtree_parent_finder.c" "OUT_BIN=bin/subtree_parent_finder" > "$OUT"
printf 'all: $(OUT_BIN)
' >> "$OUT"
printf $'\tmkdir -p bin
' >> "$OUT"
printf $'\t$(CC) $(CFLAGS) $(SRC) -o $(OUT_BIN) $(LDFLAGS)
' >> "$OUT"
printf 'clean:
\trm -rf bin
.PHONY: all clean
' >> "$OUT"
# Create start.sh that discovers workspace via WS env or relative location
cat > "$WS/start.sh" <<'START'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
# Discover workspace: prefer WS env, else derive from script location
if [ -n "${WS:-}" ]; then
  ROOT="$WS"
else
  ROOT=$(realpath "$(dirname "$(realpath "$0")")/..")
fi
cd "$ROOT"
make -s
# Run binary in foreground for deterministic capture
./bin/subtree_parent_finder
START
chmod +x "$WS/start.sh"
# Note: scaffolding intentionally overwrites files for automation; idempotent on repeat
exit 0

steps.name: testing - create robust python test runner and optional valgrind check
steps.description: Generate a Python3 test runner under tests/ that validates the built binary output equals '42'. Runner validates WS env var or derives workspace from caller. Uses subprocess timeout parameter to avoid depending on external timeout binary. Optionally runs valgrind if VALGRIND_FORCE=1 or valgrind is present and ASAN not used.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/subtree-parent-finder-3384-3393/native_c_subtree_parent_finder"
cd "$WS"
make -s
# Create python test runner that is robust to missing WS and does not require external timeout
cat > "$WS/tests/run_tests.py" <<'PY'
#!/usr/bin/env python3
import os,sys,subprocess
# Resolve workspace: require WS env variable set by caller; fallback to script-relative workspace
env_ws=os.environ.get('WS')
if env_ws:
    WS=env_ws
else:
    # script is in <WS>/tests
    WS=os.path.realpath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), '..'))
BIN=os.path.join(WS,'bin','subtree_parent_finder')
if not os.path.exists(BIN):
    print('TEST_FAIL: binary missing at '+BIN,file=sys.stderr); sys.exit(2)
try:
    proc = subprocess.run([BIN], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5)
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
    print('TEST_FAIL: execution timed out',file=sys.stderr); sys.exit(3)
except Exception as e:
    print('TEST_FAIL: failed to run binary: '+str(e),file=sys.stderr); sys.exit(4)
out = proc.stdout.strip()
if out != '42':
    print('TEST_FAIL: expected 42, got '+out,file=sys.stderr); sys.exit(5)
print('TEST_PASS')
PY
chmod +x "$WS/tests/run_tests.py"
# Optionally run valgrind if explicitly requested and ASAN not used
USE_VALGRIND=0
if [ "${VALGRIND_FORCE:-0}" = "1" ]; then USE_VALGRIND=1; fi
if command -v valgrind >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ "${VALGRIND_FORCE:-0}" != "0" ]; then USE_VALGRIND=1; fi
# Detect if ASAN enabled in Makefile
if grep -q "-fsanitize=address" "$WS/Makefile" >/dev/null 2>&1; then ASAN=1; else ASAN=0; fi
if [ "$USE_VALGRIND" -eq 1 ] && [ "$ASAN" -eq 0 ]; then
  # run under valgrind with short timeout (use timeout if available)
  if command -v timeout >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    timeout 5 valgrind --leak-check=full --error-exitcode=4 "$WS/bin/subtree_parent_finder" >/dev/null || { echo 'VALGRIND_FAIL' >&2; exit 6; }
  else
    # fallback shell watchdog for valgrind
    "$WS/bin/subtree_parent_finder" &
    pid=$!
    (sleep 5 && kill -9 "$pid" >/dev/null 2>&1) &
    watcher=$!
    wait "$pid" || true
    kill -9 "$watcher" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  fi
fi
# Run the Python test runner with WS exported for clarity
WS="$WS" python3 "$WS/tests/run_tests.py"
exit 0

steps.name: validation - build, start (with watchdog), test, collect evidence and stop cleanly
steps.description: Build project, run start.sh with enforced timeout (prefer GNU timeout, otherwise shell watchdog), capture stdout and stderr to separate limited-size evidence files, run test runner, and clean up build artifacts. Fail fast if required utilities missing or if timeouts occur.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/subtree-parent-finder-3384-3393/native_c_subtree_parent_finder"
cd "$WS"
# Build and capture build output
make -s || { echo 'ERROR: build failed' >&2; exit 3; }
STDOUT_EVID=$(mktemp)
STDERR_EVID=$(mktemp)
# Run start.sh with timeout: prefer timeout utility, else use shell watchdog
TIMEOUT_SECS=5
if command -v timeout >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if ! timeout "$TIMEOUT_SECS" bash ./start.sh >"$STDOUT_EVID" 2>"$STDERR_EVID"; then
    head -c 10000 "$STDOUT_EVID" >&2 || true
    head -c 10000 "$STDERR_EVID" >&2 || true
    echo "RAN_BINARY_STDOUT:<truncated>"; echo "RAN_BINARY_STDERR:<truncated>"
    rm -f "$STDOUT_EVID" "$STDERR_EVID"
    echo 'ERROR: binary run failed or timed out' >&2
    exit 6
  fi
else
  # shell watchdog: background start, kill after TIMEOUT_SECS
  bash ./start.sh >"$STDOUT_EVID" 2>"$STDERR_EVID" &
  pid=$!
  (sleep "$TIMEOUT_SECS" && kill -TERM "$pid" >/dev/null 2>&1 && sleep 1 && kill -KILL "$pid" >/dev/null 2>&1) &
  wd=$!
  wait "$pid" || true
  kill -9 "$wd" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
fi
# Emit limited evidence (separate stdout/stderr) and keep it concise
echo -n "RAN_BINARY_STDOUT:"; head -c 10000 "$STDOUT_EVID" | tr '\n' ' ' || true; echo
echo -n "RAN_BINARY_STDERR:"; head -c 10000 "$STDERR_EVID" | tr '\n' ' ' || true; echo
rm -f "$STDOUT_EVID" "$STDERR_EVID"
# Run tests; propagate failures
WS="$WS" python3 "$WS/tests/run_tests.py" || { echo 'TESTS_FAILED' >&2; exit 5; }
# Clean up artifacts
make clean >/dev/null || true
echo 'VALIDATION_OK'
exit 0

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/subtree-parent-finder-3384-3393/native_c_subtree_parent_finder"
cd "$WS"
# Ensure minimal tools
for tool in gcc make python3 realpath; do
  command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ERROR: required '$tool' not found" >&2; exit 2; }
done
mkdir -p .init
# Build
if ! make -s; then echo 'ERROR: build failed' >&2; exit 3; fi
# prepare evidence files
STDOUT_EVID=$(mktemp)
STDERR_EVID=$(mktemp)
TIMEOUT_SECS=5
# run with preferred timeout if available
if command -v timeout >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if ! timeout "$TIMEOUT_SECS" bash ./start.sh >"$STDOUT_EVID" 2>"$STDERR_EVID"; then
    head -c 10000 "$STDOUT_EVID" >&2 || true
    head -c 10000 "$STDERR_EVID" >&2 || true
    echo "RAN_BINARY_STDOUT:<truncated>"; echo "RAN_BINARY_STDERR:<truncated>"
    rm -f "$STDOUT_EVID" "$STDERR_EVID"
    echo 'ERROR: binary run failed or timed out' >&2
    exit 6
  fi
else
  bash ./start.sh >"$STDOUT_EVID" 2>"$STDERR_EVID" &
  pid=$!
  (sleep "$TIMEOUT_SECS" && kill -TERM "$pid" >/dev/null 2>&1 && sleep 1 && kill -KILL "$pid" >/dev/null 2>&1) &
  wd=$!
  wait "$pid" || true
  kill -9 "$wd" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
fi
# Emit limited evidence
echo -n "RAN_BINARY_STDOUT:"; head -c 10000 "$STDOUT_EVID" | tr '\n' ' ' || true; echo
echo -n "RAN_BINARY_STDERR:"; head -c 10000 "$STDERR_EVID" | tr '\n' ' ' || true; echo
rm -f "$STDOUT_EVID" "$STDERR_EVID"
# Run tests
WS="$WS" python3 "$WS/tests/run_tests.py" || { echo 'TESTS_FAILED' >&2; make clean >/dev/null || true; exit 5; }
# Clean up
make clean >/dev/null || true
echo 'VALIDATION_OK'
